Assistant: I can provide a list of available doctors in your area who are qualified and licensed to prescribe medication for pain and other treatments. The list is available here: [link]. You can also call and ask your doctor for a referral to a specialist that fits your needs.

Please consult with a licensed physician for an evaluation and treatment recommendation.
